label: PF Backlog 584
title: Eventing SSOT: API surface - SSE GET /events/stream + subscription CRUD (edge decision)
body:
## Problem / why
The UI needs push (SSE) and subscription management; no stream endpoint exists on the API-first surface.

## Goal / value
SSE stream + subscription CRUD exposed via edits to existing API routes; edge ownership decided in E1.

## In scope
- GET /events/stream (SSE) + subscription POST/GET/PATCH/DELETE (edits to existing routers; no new .py).

## Out of scope
- Legacy dashboard websocket (E11); UI implementation.

## Acceptance criteria
- A client subscribes to the stream and receives live events; subscription CRUD persists via the registry.

## Verification / test plan
- SSE smoke test; subscription CRUD contract test.
